html:
An extinct species of small human that lived on the island of Flores in Indonesia, announced to the world in 2004. Its discoverers nicknamed it "the hobbit".

In 2003 an Australian and Indonesian team digging in the cave of Liang Bua found the skeleton of an adult only about 1.1 metres tall, with a brain about the size of a chimpanzee's. More bones followed, from several individuals, along with stone tools. Later dating showed these people lived on Flores until about 50,000 years ago, near the time modern humans reached the region.

The find caused an uproar. Some scientists argued the skeleton was a modern human with a disease. Most now accept it as a separate species. Its ancestors may have been Homo erectus, like Java Man on the next island west, and shrank over time on an island with little food, as large animals often do.

It showed that several kinds of humans shared the earth until recently, and that human evolution in Asia was more varied than anyone had thought.
sum: An extinct species of small human that lived on the island of Flores in Indonesia, announced to the world in 2004. Its discoverers nicknamed it "the hobbit".
